title: The Martel band's territory and first hearing Evan Thomas
summary: The Martels never traveled beyond southwest Louisiana; Joe first heard Evan Thomas in Opelousas playing I Love You Truly as a waltz.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Like I say, Toots Johnson's band...the New Orleans musicians used to talk about that band a lot. A lot of them went there and played, and went back to New Orleans.
But that Martel band, I don't know much about it...
No, no, they never went no place.
Except for southwest Louisiana. That was close to New Iberia. And that band, the Black Devils, came out of Placamon(?), Louisiana, which was close...
Who was in that band? Do you remember? Now, there's a band I haven't heard about.

I don't even know... Evan Thomas come out of one of those bands, or he had played at one time with both of them. But the first time I heard Evan Thomas was in Opelousas, Louisiana, and we went to hear him. And before we got to this dance hall, I heard that trumpet playing...they was playing "I Love You Truly" in a waltz time. I was with a couple of the Martel guys, because I was playing with the Martels, and I said, "What instrument is that? Who's playing that way?" And one of the Martel guys said, "I think that's Evan Thomas." I had never heard him.
